polish.card: Clearer and shorter, in your own voice.
polish.about: Polish rewrites your text to read clearer and shorter, and keeps it sounding like you.
polish.before: ok so um the overlay thing, when you press the read shortcut while its already dictating it kind of breaks. can you make it so dictation wins and read just waits, and dont touch the settings page
polish.after: When I press the Read Aloud shortcut during dictation, the overlay breaks. Make dictation take priority and have Read Aloud wait. Don't touch the settings page.

prompt.card: Turns a rambling request into a clear task for an AI coding tool.
prompt.chip: turns selected text into a prompt
prompt.about: Prompt turns a rambling request into a clear task for an AI coding tool: the goal first, then the details.
prompt.before: so basically can you like make the history page not jump when a new entry comes in, keep the scroll where it was, and also dont touch the settings page
prompt.after:
Goal: stop the History page from jumping when a new entry arrives.
- Keep the scroll position where it was.
- Don't change the settings page.

humanize.about: Humanize takes out stiff, AI-sounding phrasing so the text reads like a person wrote it.
humanize.before: I hope this message finds you well. I wanted to reach out to delve into the robust new overlay, which seamlessly elevates the experience.
humanize.after: Quick note on the new overlay: it's faster and gets out of the way.

grammar.card: Only spelling and grammar. Nothing else changes.
grammar.about: Fix grammar corrects spelling, grammar and punctuation, and leaves every other word as you wrote it.
grammar.before: i has went to the store yesterday and buyed three apple
grammar.after: I went to the store yesterday and bought three apples.
